scope: Independent CPU review only; no implementation, GPU deployment, queue changes or actual capture analysis by reviewer.
required_success_evidence: Both new native/global_weak trajectories pass their own complete20forward/1000block/zero-extra gate.
Each step9/19 capture byteSHA and state identity matches its own new trajectory.
Each capture passes exact frozen numerical policy; four per-capture receipts, no inherited old pass.
New video SHA matches current annotations, all three frozen source events retained or explicitly missing.
All four probability combinations at each step use matching time/probe/head geometry and valid masks/spans.
Same-query primary source windows; generated-output event windows only descriptive.
Cross-key contributions sum to paired total; all T/H/P arrays and padded support retained with masks.
Pending inputs produce no computed numerical results; failed known gates remain rejection.
Frozen historical failure and policies remain unchanged.
independent_negative_tests: Missing whole weak trajectory must stay pending with zero result entries.
Swap one method/step capture or video/gate binding must reject.
One numerical receipt wrong capture/policy/failure must reject.
Cross-method spatial probe indices, valid bins or spans mismatch must reject.
A one-head cross tensor must not broadcast into56heads.
Uniform/constant-Q synthetic controls cannot inherit improvement from different generated event labels.
Dense scalar oracle checks four-Q/K mean attribution and padding.
not_claimed: A passing software gate does not establish semantic phase identifiability.
CPU toy integration is not a new trained-model run.
